name: @levonis/svc-notifications
description: levonis-notifications — the durable outbox-shaped inbox, the in-app notification store, and the two transports (Resend email, Telegram bot) moved out of the core as adapters: delivery is disabled unless the transport's secret NAMES exist, the provider Idempotency-Key is the event key, and the monolith keeps its own copies until Phase 3.
